notes: Pages opened (1 of 1-2): List of Zhou dynasty states. No separate Wikipedia article was found under the titles tried, so identity.wikipedia is null; Wikidata id left null (unreachable). SOURCE: one table row, read twice (columns: Name of state | Hanzi | Family | Present location | Title | Start and end year | Conqueror). The zheng dossier (ea-01-d) carries the 763 gain with the Zhengzhou 25 km disc, which lies some 130 km north of Luohe: the zheng dossier says its states table 'does not locate' Hu, so this location would let it move the gain. A second Hu, Nanhu (Fuyang, ?-496, Chu), is a different state. The start year is a bridge. The disc and the capital dot are the researcher's reading of the county or town named in the row (coordinates, since the gazetteer lacks most of these places). AREA: none. No rulers, no capitals, no wars on the list.
